name: model-preflight
description: Checks model and effort fit before work, states a verdict, and offers an independent agent or pauses for a session switch when needed. Maps tasks separately for Claude, Codex and ChatGPT Work, and ChatGPT Chat. Uses a PowerShell 7 or POSIX sh hook on supported hosts and a skill where hooks do not run.
